name: Okunote Maki
source:
A resident of Uruoi-so. She lives in Room 1.

She is a married woman, but is currently separated from her husband.

She has a flirtatious personality and makes advances toward Shichirouta.

[from [url=https://winters.world.coocan.jp/newpage152.html]official site[/url]]
